lessons.title: God who made you
lessons.summary: The Bible begins with God as Creator. People are made in his image and made to know him.
questions: What does it mean to be made in God's image?
According to Acts 17:27, how near is God?

lessons.title: What went wrong
lessons.summary: Humanity turned away from God. The Bible calls this sin and describes its result as death.
questions: What two things are contrasted in Romans 6:23?

lessons.title: Who is Jesus?
lessons.summary: The Gospels introduce Jesus as the Christ, the Son of God, who came to live among us.
questions: What did people say about Jesus in Mark 8?
Who do you say he is?

lessons.title: The cross and forgiveness
lessons.summary: The New Testament teaches that Jesus died for sins and rose again, so people can be forgiven.
questions: How does Isaiah 53 describe the one who suffers?
What do we have in Christ, according to Colossians 1:14?

lessons.title: Repentance and faith
lessons.summary: Jesus called people to repent and believe the good news. Salvation is received by faith as a gift.
questions: What two responses does Mark 1:15 call for?
Why is salvation called a gift?

lessons.title: A new life
lessons.summary: Those who follow Jesus begin a new life, growing together with other believers.
questions: What does 'new creation' mean to you?
What next step will you take?
